notes: Compound cToken (CDai delegate, solc 0.5.17, no via-IR). Text is faithful on every path checked: accrueInterest, seize, transfer/transferFrom, _becomeImplementation, _resignImplementation, _reduceReserves, the redeem/mint/liquidate flows (error codes, Failure events, JTokenBalance/JTokenStatus events, storage writes, call order). Large functions reviewed by structure (redeem 1567 lines, liquidateBorrow 1169, mint 1105, redeemUnderlying 956). No loop in the source or the text. P12 is high because the decompiler copies each continuation into the early-return arm of accrueInterest and into both arms of exchangeRateStoredInternal (mintFresh twice, doTransferIn four times in mint); estimate. P10 counts the (MathError, value) SSA pairs (estimate). P11: SafeMath.sub(totalReserves, reduceAmount) after `if reduceAmount <= totalReserves`. P14: Exp mantissas and RedeemLocalVars fields read as mem[224], mem[256], mem[288]. Events JTokenBalance/JTokenStatus show raw topics (not in the signature database). Duplicate extcodesize checks on the same address are elided soundly. In _becomeImplementation the approve argument prints as `Bytes(12, 0), mem[172 len 20]` (one address word shown as two values) and the abi.decode results as mem[172 len 20]/mem[204 len 20].
summary: Faithful, mostly readable Compound cToken text with no loops; the main problems are one function (redeemUnderlying) whose second half falls back to raw memory after a free-pointer merge, and verbose CarefulMath error-flag plumbing duplicated across many early-return arms.
